summary: Röko AB (publ) is a private equity firm specializing in lower middle market, small- and medium-sized businesses. The firm prefers to invest in B2B and B2C markets. The firm typically invests in European region. It typically invests in companies with EBITDA between EUR 2 million ($2.31 million) and EUR 15 million ($17.44 million), along with a margin of at least 15% and EBITDA (A) between $3 million and $15 million and revenue between $15 million and $150 million. The firm only seeks minority stakes. Roko AB (publ) was founded in 2019 and is based in Stockholm, Sweden.
